mapper.insert: insert into pcd_file_info_table(file_id, file_name, file_uploaded_time, file_size, file_type, file_author_id, file_checksum, file_node_id, file_total_chunks, file_storage_path, file_status, file_space_id) values(#{id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{uploaded_time}, #{size}, #{type}, #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{checksum}, #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{total_chunks}, #{storage_path}, #{status}, #{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler});
mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM pcd_file_info_table f WHERE ( (#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null and f.file_author_id = #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) or f.file_space_id = #{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} or (#{personalSpace} = true and f.file_space_id is null and f.file_author_id = #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) ) AND f.file_node_id IN ( SELECT descendant_id FROM pcd_directory_closure_table WHERE ancestor_id = #{nodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} ) AND f.file_status NOT IN ('trashed', 'deleted', 'merging', 'merge_failed', 'scanning', 'reject', 'scan_failed', 'merged') ORDER BY f.file_name ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN f.file_status IN ('TRASHED', 'DELETED') THEN TRUE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table n ON n.node_user_id = c.user_id AND n.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id AND n.node_status IN ('TRASHED', 'DELETED') LIMIT 1 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS deleted FROM pcd_file_info_table f WHERE f.file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ( (#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null and f.file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) or f.file_space_id = #{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} or (#{personalSpace} = true and f.file_space_id is null and f.file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) )

SELECT CASE MIN( CASE WHEN f.file_status = 'DELETED' OR n.node_status = 'DELETED' THEN 1
WHEN f.file_status = 'TRASHED' OR n.node_status = 'TRASHED' THEN 2
ELSE 3 END ) WHEN 1 THEN 'DELETED' WHEN 2 THEN 'TRASHED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS effective_status FROM pcd_file_info_table f LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_closure_table c ON c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table n ON n.node_user_id = c.user_id AND n.node_id = c.ancestor_id AND n.node_status IN ('TRASHED', 'DELETED') WHERE f.file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ( (#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null and f.file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) or f.file_space_id = #{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} or (#{personalSpace} = true and f.file_space_id is null and f.file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) ) GROUP BY f.file_id, f.file_status
mapper.update: update pcd_file_info_table set file_storage_path = COALESCE(#{storage_path}, file_storage_path), file_checksum = COALESCE(#{checksum}, file_checksum), file_size = COALESCE(#{file_size}, file_size), file_status = 'active' where file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} and file_status = 'merged' and ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null and file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) or file_space_id = #{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} or (#{personalSpace} = true and file_space_id is null and file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}));
mapper.delete: delete from pcd_file_info_table where file_status IN ('scan_failed', 'merge_failed', 'reject') LIMIT 1000;
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM pcd_file_info_table WHERE file_author_id = #{user_id, typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND file_status = 'active'
